summary: Repaired two details of the accepted question-level VerifyLeader record. Its rationale still opened by declaring the conclusion violated even though the record now states a question-level explanation, so that sentence is rewritten to say the question is explained, the scoped defect is asserted and the receipts' comparisons remain recorded as violated, which matches the record's fields and preserves what the experiments showed. Separately, the corrected verification entry had been reissued without its execution map, losing the links that tied it to the receipts from the supporters, lease-window, single-non-voter and end-to-end experiments; it is now reissued with the same corrected statement and the full seven-receipt execution map, including the lease receipt. The interpretation carries its complete counterevidence and limitation lists, both gap answers, the same two cited executions and the same source set, so nothing else in the account moves. Both changes validate against submission.schema.json.
